dialog.editDescription: Change the schedule, command, or target server for "{taskName}".
dialog.createDescription: Run a command on a schedule.

form.cronFormat: Format: minute hour day month weekday
form.bridgeArgsNote: Args are optional. Only allow-listed actions run via the scheduler.
form.targetServerNote: This task always runs against this server, even if a different one is active when it fires.

fieldHelp.taskName: A label to identify this scheduled task in the list and execution history.
fieldHelp.taskNameContext: Purely cosmetic — it has no effect on when or what the task runs. Pick something that tells you at a glance what it does.
fieldHelp.frequency: How often the simple builder fires this task: every hour, every few hours, or once a day at a specific time.
fieldHelp.frequencyContext: Switch to the Advanced (Cron) tab for schedules this builder cannot express, such as specific weekdays.
fieldHelp.cronExpression: Raw 5-field cron expression: minute, hour, day, month, weekday.
fieldHelp.cronExpressionContext: A malformed expression is rejected on save. Use the Simple Builder tab unless you need a schedule it cannot express.
fieldHelp.command: The action this task runs when it fires — a raw RCON command or a PanelBridge action.
fieldHelp.commandContext: Destructive actions like restart run immediately with no in-game warning, unlike the countdown-based restart tools above.
fieldHelp.targetServer: Which server instance this task runs against when it fires.
fieldHelp.targetServerContext: The task always targets this server, even if a different instance is active in the panel at fire time — useful for multi-server setups.
fieldHelp.restartCountdown: Minutes of warning players get before the server restarts.
fieldHelp.restartCountdownContext: Countdowns under 5 minutes can catch players mid-fight or mid-drive — the panel asks for confirmation below that threshold.
fieldHelp.modUpdateRestart: Whether a restart is currently queued because an installed mod has an available update.
fieldHelp.modUpdateRestartContext: This tile only reports status — configure whether mod updates trigger an automatic restart from the Mods page.

manualRestart.title: Manual Restart
manualRestart.descriptionRunning: Pick a countdown — players are warned and the server restarts when it ends.
manualRestart.descriptionOffline: Server is offline — start it before issuing a restart.
manualRestart.restart15mTitle: Restart in 15 minutes with countdown warnings
manualRestart.restart10mTitle: Restart in 10 minutes with countdown warnings
manualRestart.restart5mTitle: Restart in 5 minutes with countdown warnings
manualRestart.restart1mTitle: Restart in 1 minute — short warning, requires confirmation
manualRestart.restartConfirmDesc: Players get a single 1-minute warning before the server goes down. Use longer countdowns if anyone is mid-fight or driving.
manualRestart.countdownWarning: Players see countdown warnings at 15m, 10m, 5m, and 1m as the timer ticks down.
manualRestart.shortCountdownWarning: Short countdowns can catch players mid-action. Confirm if you really want to restart this fast.
